purpose: Right after a company-page hero, state the mission or point of view in one large paragraph with a bold opening phrase, then hand the visitor straight to the next action.

behaviour.note: Sits directly after the page hero on both routes (About: after the teal hero header; Careers: after the header with the pattern image).

About variant is built from the shared Section, SectionLabel and Lead helpers with an id of mission and the background colour; the Lead column is wide (10/18/16 columns). Careers variant is a plain section (no label, no pattern) with a larger text size (text-3xl) and one CTA that jumps to the openings anchor.

variants.name: about-mission
variants.description: Labelled section (icon plus eyebrow), Lead paragraph at text-2xl, two CTAs side by side from sm (primary and outline).

variants.name: careers-brutal
variants.description: Unlabelled plain section with a text-3xl paragraph and a single primary CTA linking to an in-page anchor.

label.note: Eyebrow label with an icon; about-mission only. Observed 2 words.

lead.note: Bold opening phrase followed by plain text. Observed: about-mission 49 words, careers-brutal 26 words (own count; the inventory's 31 to 58 was not reproduced).

ctas.note: about-mission: two (See open roles primary, Get started outline). careers-brutal: one (View openings primary, anchor href).

motion.reducedMotionNote: No motion in the source; no prefers-reduced-motion handling exists in the code.
